title: J. Andrew Kissner's 1994-95 interviews with legacy program insiders

tellings.quote: >> And so in 1994, 1995, he conducted a series of interviews with firsthand legacy people all across the board.

plain: An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2026 that in 1994 and 1995 a man named J. Andrew Kissner carried out a series of interviews in New Mexico with firsthand insiders from secret long-running government programs, which UAPGerb calls legacy programs, going back as far as 1947. The telling also names the journalist Linda Moulton Howe and the wartime science official Vannevar Bush. If true, those interviews would be direct testimony from inside a hidden UFO program.
